title: Redirects
description: content/redirects.json: old addresses that should keep working. For each entry the build writes an HTML page at `from` that forwards to the page in the visitor's language (stored choice, then browser language, then site.sourceLocale). A builder with server-side routing can turn these into 301 redirects instead.

from.description: Old path, e.g. "/ourparish.html". Must not collide with a built path (/<locale>/..., /assets/...).
